answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the forge of free entry disappears, the willow of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the grove case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while.
